post.description:
Updates the agent's key binding to a new provider API key hash. The agent ID, traces, alignment card, integrity score, and trust edges are fully preserved.

**Security model**: Your API key is hashed on your device (SHA-256) before transmission — the raw key is never sent to Mnemom servers.

**Named agents**: If this agent was registered with a name (via `x-mnemom-agent`), hash the new key as `SHA256(newKey + '|' + agentName)` before submitting.

**Conflict**: If the new key was already used and auto-created a new agent, the endpoint returns `409` with the conflicting agent ID.

new_key_hash.description: First 16 hex characters of SHA256(newApiKey) for unnamed agents, or SHA256(newApiKey + '|' + agentName) for named agents. Compute client-side — do not transmit the raw key.

key_prefix.description: First 16 characters of the new provider API key. Stored for display — not sensitive. If provided, returned in the response.

200.description: Agent successfully re-bound to the new key.

409.description: The new key is already bound to another agent.

post.description:
Checks whether a given API key hash matches the key currently bound to this agent. The raw key is hashed client-side — only the hash is transmitted.

**Named agents**: hash as `SHA256(key + '|' + agentName)` before submitting.

Returns `key_prefix` of the registered key regardless of match result — useful for debugging.

key_hash.description: First 16 hex chars of SHA256(apiKey) or SHA256(apiKey + '|' + agentName) for named agents.

bound.description: True if the submitted hash matches the registered key.

key_prefix.description: First 16 chars of the registered key, or null if not yet captured.

**Requires ServiceRole authentication.** This endpoint is only accessible to platform administrators with the Supabase service role key. Regular API keys and user tokens cannot access this endpoint.

Admin-only endpoint returning active endpoints count, 24h success rate, disabled endpoints, and top event types.
List all active Ed25519 signing public keys. Public endpoint, no authentication required. These keys are used to verify IntegrityCertificate signatures.

post.description: Verify an IntegrityCertificate. Performs Ed25519 signature verification, chain hash verification, Merkle inclusion proof verification, input commitment check, and optional STARK proof verification. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

400.description: Invalid request body or certificate structure

get.description: Retrieve or reconstruct the IntegrityCertificate for a checkpoint. Includes signature, chain proof, Merkle inclusion proof (if available), and verdict derivation proof (if completed). Public endpoint, no authentication required.

get.description: Generate and return a Merkle inclusion proof for a checkpoint. The proof contains O(log N) sibling hashes sufficient to recompute the Merkle root, proving the checkpoint is included in the agent's complete checkpoint history. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

404.description: Checkpoint not found or no Merkle proof available

422.description: Merkle leaf index out of bounds

post.description: Request a zero-knowledge proof for a checkpoint's verdict derivation. If a proof already exists, returns its current status. Otherwise, creates a pending proof request and dispatches it to the SP1 prover service. Requires API key authentication.

200.description: Proof already exists for this checkpoint

get.description: Get the ZK proof status and data for a checkpoint. Returns the most recent proof record including status, proof type, verification result, and timing metadata. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

404.description: No proof found for this checkpoint

get.description: Get the current Merkle tree root for an agent. The root is a SHA-256 hash that commits to the complete set of integrity checkpoints for this agent. Public endpoint, no authentication required.

post.description: Reclassify a previously recorded AIP checkpoint violation. This allows operators to correct false positives or adjust severity after manual review. The reclassification is recorded in the audit trail and can trigger a score recomputation.

post.description: Analyze alignment fault lines across a team of agents. Identifies capabilities, values, or constraints that some agents declare but others miss, creating potential alignment gaps. Returns a fleet-wide score with individual fault line details and resolution hints.

post.description: Create a new guarded transaction. The transaction wraps one or more agent actions with CLPI policy guardrails, ensuring all tool invocations are evaluated against the effective policy before execution. Returns the transaction ID and initial evaluation status.

delete.description: Delete a guarded transaction. Only transactions in pending or completed status can be deleted. Active transactions must be completed or cancelled first.

post.description: Creates a new user account. When email confirmation is required on the Supabase project, returns `{ user, email_confirmation_required: true }` without issuing a session cookie; the user must click the email link. When auto-confirm is on, issues `mnemom_session` and returns `{ user }`.

redirect_to.description: Allowlisted SPA path to return to after email confirmation.

200.description: Account created. Either returns a full session (auto-confirm) or awaits email confirmation.

503.description: Auth is not configured on this deployment.

post.description: Server-enforces SSO for org-enforced domains (returns 403 with `code: sso_required`). For users with a verified TOTP factor, returns 200 `{ mfa_required: true, factor_id }` and sets a short-lived `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie; otherwise issues `mnemom_session` and returns `{ user }`.

200.description: Full session issued OR MFA step-up required.

Set-Cookie.description: `mnemom_session` on full session, or `mnemom_mfa_pending` on MFA step-up.

503.description: Auth is not configured on this deployment.

post.summary: Sign out and clear session cookies
post.description: Revokes the refresh token upstream and clears `mnemom_session` + `mnemom_mfa_pending`.

get.description: Minimal whoami endpoint. Returns `{ user }` when the `mnemom_session` cookie is valid; returns 401 otherwise. Preferred over `GET /auth/me` for cookie-only browser sessions — `/auth/me` is bearer-only and preserves its legacy response shape unchanged.

post.summary: Issue a challenge for a TOTP factor
post.description: Called during the sign-in MFA step-up flow (using the `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie) or during enrollment verification (using the existing `mnemom_session`). Returns a `challenge_id` to pass to `/auth/mfa/verify`.

Sign-in flow: consumes the `mnemom_mfa_pending` cookie, verifies the TOTP code, and issues a full `mnemom_session`. Enrollment flow: verifies a freshly-enrolled factor using the current session and upgrades it to aal2.

200.description: Full session issued. Response sets `mnemom_session` cookie.

get.summary: List the current user's TOTP factors

post.description: Returns the TOTP secret + provisioning URI for a QR code. Factor starts in `unverified` state until `/auth/mfa/verify` is called against it.
Requires an aal2 session (freshly MFA-verified). Returns 403 `code: aal2_required` if the session isn't aal2.

403.description: Current session isn't aal2; re-verify MFA and retry.

post.description: Always returns 200 on 4xx upstream responses (to avoid user enumeration). 5xx upstream errors surface as 5xx to the caller.

redirect_to.description: Allowlisted SPA path to return to after the user clicks the reset link.

post.description: Re-sends the signup confirmation email for a pending account.

Looks up the SSO provider for the email's domain, generates PKCE + HMAC-signed state, sets a short-lived `mnemom_sso_initiator` cookie, and returns the IdP URL for the SPA to `window.location.href` to.

redirect_after.description: SPA path to return to after SSO completes (allowlisted).

200.description: IdP URL returned. Also sets `mnemom_sso_initiator` cookie.

404.description: No SSO provider configured for this domain.

503.description: SSO is not configured on this deployment.

get.summary: IdP callback landing — issues session and redirects to SPA
get.description: Validates the HMAC-signed state (from the `mnemom_sso_initiator` cookie), consumes the single-use nonce, exchanges the PKCE code, enforces domain + org binding, performs SSO identity linking (T3-2c), and issues `mnemom_session` via a 302 to the SPA's `redirect_after` path.

302.description: Session issued. Redirects to the SPA.

403.description: Email domain doesn't match the org's allowed domains.

get.description: Handles Supabase-hosted email links. Verifies the token via GoTrue, issues `mnemom_session` when the flow returns tokens (signup confirm, magic link), or redirects without a session for recovery flows where the SPA performs the next step.

302.description: Redirects to the SPA. Sets `mnemom_session` when tokens are issued.

Set-Cookie.description: Optional; only when tokens are issued.

post.summary: Exchange a cookie session for raw Supabase tokens
post.description: One-shot endpoint called by the SPA during the CLI login flow (browser → localhost handoff). Requires a valid `mnemom_session`. Returns access + refresh tokens in the JSON body. Does not modify cookies.

post.summary: CLI password login — returns bearer tokens in JSON body
post.description: Legacy CLI-targeted endpoint. Unlike `/auth/sign-in`, this does NOT set cookies — it returns Supabase access + refresh tokens in the JSON body for the CLI to persist at `~/.mnemom/auth.json`. Rate-limited.
Legacy CLI-targeted refresh grant. Trades a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. Rate-limited.

post.summary: Begin passkey enrollment — return WebAuthn creation options
post.description: Authenticated endpoint. Returns `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions` for the SPA to pass to `navigator.credentials.create()`. Stores the challenge in KV with a 30-second TTL; the companion `/verify-enroll` endpoint consumes it. `excludeCredentials` is pre-populated with the user's existing passkeys so the authenticator prevents duplicate enrollment of the same key.

200.description: WebAuthn creation options. Shape follows the WebAuthn Level 3 spec.

503.description: Passkeys are not configured on this deployment.

post.summary: Verify a passkey registration response + persist the credential
post.description: Authenticated endpoint. Consumes the challenge issued by `/auth/passkey/enroll`, verifies the attestation via `@simplewebauthn/server`, and inserts a row into `user_passkeys`. A user-supplied `friendly_name` is stored alongside for UI display.

post.summary: Begin passkey sign-in — return WebAuthn assertion options
post.description: Unauthenticated. Returns `PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions` with an empty `allowCredentials` list (discoverable-credentials flow). The browser surfaces any matching passkey for this RP without needing the user to enter an email. Rate-limited.

post.summary: Verify a passkey assertion and issue a session
post.description: Unauthenticated. Consumes the challenge issued by `/auth/passkey/challenge`, verifies the assertion via `@simplewebauthn/server`, mints Supabase tokens via `admin.generateLink(magiclink)` for the resolved user (same pattern T3-2c uses for SSO identity linking), and issues `mnemom_session` with `auth_method: 'passkey'`. Counter is enforced monotonically — a decrement rejects the assertion.

get.summary: List the current user's enrolled passkeys
get.description: Returns the safe subset of `user_passkeys` for the authenticated user (omits public_key, counter, last_used_ip).

delete.description: Requires aal2. Deleting a passkey does not affect other passkeys or the password/MFA fallback; those remain usable.

404.description: Passkey not found for this user.

get.summary: List trust edges from or to an agent
get.description: Returns trust-relationship edges that the agent participates in. `direction=outbound` returns edges originating from this agent; `inbound` returns edges pointing at this agent; `both` (default) deduplicates.

post.summary: Create a trust edge from this agent to another
post.description: Caller must own the `from` agent (or be an admin). `weight` is clamped to [0, 1] with default 0.5. Returns 409 if an edge already exists in the same direction.

403.description: Caller does not own the source agent.

404.description: Source or target agent not found.

409.description: A trust edge already exists between these agents in this direction.

delete.description: Caller must own the source agent (`from_agent`) or be an admin. Either source or target agent id may appear in the path.

403.description: Caller does not own the source agent.

404.description: Edge not found, or the edge does not touch this agent.

BearerAuth.description: Supabase JWT token in Authorization: Bearer header

ServiceRole.description: Supabase service role key for admin and service endpoints

CookieAuth.name: mnemom_session
CookieAuth.description: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie issued by /v1/auth/sign-in (or the SSO / email-callback flows). The value is an AES-256-GCM-encrypted blob of {access_token, refresh_token, issued_at, auth_method}. Browser clients include this automatically with `credentials: "include"`.

card_json.description: Full alignment card JSON per AAP spec

key.description: Full secret key, only returned on creation

WebhookEndpoint.description: Webhook endpoint with signing secret (only returned on creation and secret rotation)

signing_secret.description: 32-byte hex-encoded HMAC signing secret. Only returned on creation and rotation.

event_types.description: Subscribed event types. Empty array means all events.

WebhookEndpointPublic.description: Webhook endpoint without signing secret (used in list and get responses)

last_response_status.description: HTTP status code from last delivery attempt

SigningKeyInfo.description: Ed25519 signing key metadata. Public keys are used to verify IntegrityCertificate signatures.

is_active.description: Whether the key is currently in use for new signatures

IntegrityCertificate.description: Machine-readable cryptographic certificate for an integrity checkpoint. Modeled on C2PA content credentials and W3C Verifiable Credentials.

subject.description: Identifies the checkpoint this certificate attests to

thinking_block_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the thinking block

card_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the Alignment Card

combined_commitment.description: SHA-256 of all input fields concatenated

signed_payload.description: Deterministic JSON string that was signed

merkle.description: Merkle inclusion proof. Null if not yet added to tree.

verdict_derivation.description: SP1 STARK proof. Null if not yet proven.

MerkleRootResponse.description: Current Merkle tree root and metadata for an agent

leaf_count.description: Total number of checkpoint leaves in the tree

last_updated.description: When the tree was last updated

InclusionProofResponse.description: Merkle inclusion proof for a checkpoint

leaf_hash.description: SHA-256 leaf hash of this checkpoint

leaf_index.description: Index of this leaf in the tree

siblings.description: O(log N) sibling hashes for proof verification

position.description: Position of sibling relative to the path node

tree_size.description: Total number of leaves in the tree

verified.description: Whether the proof was verified against the stored root

ProofStatusResponse.description: ZK proof status and metadata for a checkpoint

checkpoint_id.description: The checkpoint this proof is for

image_id.description: Guest program image ID (set when proving begins)

proving_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock proving time in milliseconds (set when completed)

verified.description: Whether the proof has been verified

verified_at.description: When the proof was verified (null if not yet verified)

created_at.description: When the proof request was created

updated_at.description: When the proof record was last updated

merkle.description: Null if Merkle proof was not present in the certificate

verdict_derivation.description: Null if verdict derivation proof was not present

OrgConscienceValue.description: A custom conscience value for an organization

OrgConscienceAuditEntry.description: Audit log entry for conscience value changes

OrgCardTemplate.description: Organization alignment card template that all agents inherit

created_by.description: User ID who created the template

updated_by.description: User ID who last updated the template

PolicyMeta.description: Metadata for a CLPI policy including schema version, name, description, and scope.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the policy schema (e.g. '1.0.0')

description.description: Detailed description of the policy's purpose

scope.description: Scope at which the policy applies

CapabilityMapping.description: Maps a named capability to specific tools and alignment card actions.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this capability represents

tools.description: List of tool identifiers that belong to this capability

card_actions.description: Alignment card action types associated with this capability

ForbiddenRule.description: A rule that forbids tools matching a specific pattern.

pattern.description: Glob or regex pattern matching tool identifiers to forbid

reason.description: Human-readable reason why these tools are forbidden

severity.description: Severity level when a forbidden tool is invoked

EscalationTrigger.description: Defines a condition that triggers an escalation action.

condition.description: Expression or rule describing when this trigger fires (e.g. 'violation_count > 3')

action.description: Action to take when the condition is met

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this escalation exists

PolicyDefaults.description: Default enforcement behavior for tools and situations not explicitly covered by the policy.

unmapped_tool_action.description: Action to take when a tool is not mapped to any capability

unmapped_severity.description: Severity level assigned to unmapped tool invocations

fail_open.description: If true, allow actions when the policy engine is unavailable. If false, block by default.

enforcement_mode.description: Default enforcement mode for the policy

grace_period_hours.description: Number of hours to allow violations before enforcement kicks in (for new policy rollouts)

Policy.description: A complete CLPI policy document defining capability mappings, forbidden tools, escalation triggers, and enforcement defaults.

capability_mappings.description: Map of capability names to their definitions

PolicyViolation.description: A single policy violation detected during evaluation.

tool.description: Tool identifier that triggered the violation

capability.description: Capability the tool was mapped to, if any

rule.description: The specific rule or pattern that was matched

PolicyEvaluationResult.description: Result of evaluating a CLPI policy against a set of tools or traces.

card_gaps.description: Gaps between the policy and the alignment card

coverage.description: Fraction of tools covered by the policy (0.0 to 1.0)

ReclassificationRequest.description: Request to reclassify a checkpoint violation.

checkpoint_id.description: Identifier of the checkpoint to reclassify

card_amendment_id.description: Optional ID of an alignment card amendment that triggered this reclassification

ReclassificationResult.description: Result of a checkpoint violation reclassification.

score_impact.description: Impact of the reclassification on the agent's score

FaultLine.description: A single fault line identified in team alignment analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for this fault line

value.description: The specific value, capability, or constraint that constitutes the fault line

classification.description: Classification of the fault line type

agents_declaring.description: Agent IDs that declare or satisfy this requirement

agents_missing.description: Agent IDs that are missing this requirement

impact_score.description: Estimated impact of this fault line on team alignment (0.0 to 1.0)

resolution_hint.description: Suggested action to resolve this fault line

FaultLineAnalysis.description: Complete fault line analysis result for a team.

analysis_id.description: Unique identifier for this analysis run

fault_lines.description: Identified fault lines sorted by severity

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the analysis findings

RiskForecast.description: Risk forecast for a team based on alignment trends and fault lines.

mode.description: Description of the potential failure mode

impact.description: Estimated impact if the failure occurs

failure_modes.description: Ranked list of potential failure modes

overall_risk_level.description: Overall risk level for the team

confidence.description: Confidence level of the forecast (0.0 to 1.0)

OnChainAnchorResult.description: Result of an on-chain Merkle root anchoring operation.

merkle_root.description: Hex-encoded Merkle root hash that was anchored

block_number.description: Block number in which the transaction was included

gas_used.description: Gas consumed by the anchoring transaction

chain.description: Blockchain network where the anchor was created

agent_ids.description: Agent IDs included in this anchor

anchored_at.description: Timestamp when the anchor was created

User.description: Supabase user shape. Fields beyond `id` and `email` are passthrough.

PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptionsJSON.description: WebAuthn registration options (base64url-encoded per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON serialization).

RegistrationResponseJSON.description: Browser's `navigator.credentials.create()` response, JSON-serialized per the WebAuthn Level 3 JSON form.

TrustEdge.description: Directed trust-relationship edge between two agents (CLPI Phase 3). Used by the trust-topology RPC and the team reputation scorer.
